reviews.comment: He's a great guy with chill classes and light projects and exams. You can find him occasionally in Bible Studies.

The first exam had a fair share of technical difficulties, but a lot of kids in the class are definitely on the dumber side and are quite soft. Overall Villareal is a good professor, cracks a few jokes here and there, and he cares about his students. Gave the class take home exams for exam 2 and 3 along with the final. He's a good choice.

I think Professor Villareal should teach something more suitable for himself, maybe a kindergarten class would be managable for him. He's incredibly unorganized, has no idea what is going on in class, and put no effort into the course. He hands out A's like they are candy, but didn't have more than two grades in the grade book until the last week.
Villareal is incredibly disorganized and can barely teach. The class isn't hard since he gives A's out like candy but you won't learn anything and it's an important class for the future

Lectures taken from the textbook and pretty dry, but easy to follow along and he is more than willing to answer any questions during class. Since it's a lab class, the exams aren't worth a whole lot of the grade, which is good because they're pretty hard.
reviews.ratingTags: Accessible outside class--Clear grading criteria--Beware of pop quizzes

reviews.comment: Dr. Villareal was an absolute stud. Though he did have some problems such as operating zoom and figuring out a few ecampus things, overall the course was completely manageable. He made the course interesting to learn, and though at times went a little fast, always made sure that students had the chance to ask questions if needed. Highly reccomend.

His tests are insanely difficult compared to other professors that teach this course and a lot of them have typos. He changes the quiz or hw format constantly throughout the semester and also never responds to emails. Not the best prof for this course, definitely take cantrell.
reviews.ratingTags: Skip class? You won't pass.--Test heavy--Beware of pop quizzes

reviews.comment: Want to pay hundreds of dollars for a professor who won't teach you anything? Well this guy is for you. Poorly organized lectures that most of the time make no sense to anyone in the class. The labs are the only thing that provide any sort of learning to students. If you can, take a different professor at all costs.

The worst professor I've ever had. The other ratings mentioning how disorganized he is are an understatement if anything. He can't get through an example without a student needing to correct him, not even on simple mistakes, but fundamentally incorrect approaches. It's embarrassing that he does not know his own material. Stay away at all costs.

Although like many have said he is a bit disorganized when it comes to testing, he ends up voiding some of the questions which gives you more credit. I recommend definitely reading the book because the lecture is heavy on examples from the book. He is easy to work with if there is an issue as long as you contact him before everyone else does.

Major Quizzes were extremely stressful because there were MANY mistakes or arguments on every single major quiz we took. If it involved online interaction, there was going to be a problem with it guaranteed. However, the professor did adjust and work with grades to ensure students were tested fairly rather than just leave us in the dust.
reviews.ratingTags: Get ready to read--Skip class? You won't pass.--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: By far the worst professor/teacher I have had in my nineteen years of life. Makes an easy class very difficult to understand and has made numerous issues on each Exam/Major Quiz we have taken. Avoid at all cost, there are better professors who teach this course.

Not a good teacher, he is very confused about what he is teaching. So expect to learn everything through youtube videos, which is pretty doable. 420 was an easy class, but this prof is not one you are going to learn anything from.
An absolute disgrace, didn't learn a thing from this 'professor'

The most unorganized professor I've ever had. Every test had at least 2 questions messed up, even a 3 question test did. Anything he does is disorganized: the syllabus, giving examples, giving lectures, organizing tests, organizing quizzes, literally anything you name. I normally wouldn't mind that much but something about him I cant stand at all.
reviews.ratingTags: Graded by few things--Beware of pop quizzes

reviews.comment: Nice professor and is definitely caring about his students but he's completely incompetent. He can't even solve his own lecture problems and students frequently have to correct him. He takes forever to upload class materials, which makes review impossible. On MAJOR QUIZZES (basically TESTS), he can't even make sure the answer choices are correct.

As a person, hes very nice, but being nice doesn't always correlate to being a good professor. Hes extremely disorganized, its never clear what youre supposed to be learning and he uses complex examples for topics that should be simple, making them seem way harder than they should be. Just not good at teaching. Sorry, not sorry.
Dysfunctional class

This professor is a nightmare from start to finish. He refuses to teach saying it's on us to LEARN his material. He doesn't give lectures only chapters to read followed by quizzes then graded problems on them. This is his first time teaching the course and there is no organization he changes due dates and projects as well as not posting answers.
reviews.ratingTags: Get ready to read--SO MANY PAPERS--GROUP PROJECTS

reviews.comment: Good professor and easy grader. Gives extra credit on exams for demonstrating any advanced understanding of the material. Outlines what will be on his exams. Pacing is excellent, material is covered in detail before exams and is willing to alter his exams if some material is not. Pay attention in lecture and you will do well.

Dr. Villareal, although disorganized, is a really caring prof that makes sure you learn the material. As someone with no coding experience and not even a csce/ecen major found the class very interesting and not to difficult thanks to Dr. V. His test can be long and challenge your knowledge but his class is very fair and wholistic. Would take again.
reviews.ratingTags: LOTS OF HOMEWORK--BEWARE OF POP QUIZZES--Caring

reviews.comment: Dr. Villareal is a really cool guy and caring however this class is just structured badly. Often times what was given for reading would not show up in class exercises or quizzes. The exams are also kind of difficult. The flipped style doesn't help you understand concepts and you are often left to do it all on your own.
reviews.ratingTags: Gives good feedback--Get ready to read--Skip class? You won't pass.

reviews.comment: Villareal's best trait is that he cares for his students' education and future. While the format of the class hampers his strong lecturing capabilities, he's makes the best of it. A solid choice for ECEN 248.

While there were some frustrating things about Dr. Villareal's lectures, most topics covered aren't too hard to understand. The best part about Dr. Villareal is he really seems to care that students understand and get good grades. Another thing to appreciate are the clear expectations he gives for the types of questions that will be on the tests.

He's a good professor, and quite funny. We had a project with real microcontrollers from TI instead of the LEGO robot kits. It was really cool, and a very valuable experience, but had a huge workload that came with it. Be prepared to meet up with your team outside of class a lot. Directions weren't always clear. There was occasional confusion.

If you sign up for his ENGR 112 section, beware: you are signing up for the different 112 curriculum. Instead of covering MATLAB-related stuff, you'll be doing something else called ENERGIA. It's basically completely electrical engineering - it's not that dream "engineering discernment" class you expect. I did well in the class but I hated it.

He makes problem solving a lot more difficult than it really is. Leaves a lot of grey area when answering questions which seems to do more harm than good. Class goes by quickly without feeling Ive gotten anywhere.
reviews.ratingTags: Tough Grader--Participation matters--BEWARE OF POP QUIZZES

reviews.comment: Villareal isn't the best at explaining things, but he's such a nice guy. He'll do his best to make sure that the class is as least stressful as possible for you. He really treats you like a person and doesn't want you to be stressed.

Villareal taught the special classes with the different curriculum than the other 112 classes, which I might add is 10x better than the normal sections. There was a lot less homework and a lot more interesting and practical things going on. I enjoyed Villareal's class and the humor he brought. However he wasn't the best at replying to emails.

Best prof available for 111/112. Currently does the "experimental" sections that are partnered with texas instruments as opposed to using lego mindstorms, and the project is waaaaaaay more interesting and much easier too. As long as you pay attention in class and actually do the homework, as well as show up for the study times, you'll get an A

Cares about his students learning stuff and being engaged with what is taught. The opportunity to build a robot and program it was very unique and fulfilling. Every class has some bumps along the way and you have to learn to be patient with Dr. V and his TA. Sometimes the TA takes over when Dr. V is unclear on something. A refined sense of humor.

Let me start off by saying I am not in danger of failing this class this is all just so future students know. To start off he is always at least 5-10 min late to class, I have tried to be at his office hours multiple times and he never showed up and if he did it was for the last 15 min and he just assumed you knew the material. Don't take him!
reviews.ratingTags: Get ready to read--Skip class? You won't pass.--BEWARE OF POP QUIZZES

reviews.comment: This guy is pretty good, and it is actually easy to get an A in his class if you follow the lecture completely because his tests & quizzes, ( but not HW) are based 100% off of the lecture.

Dr. Villareal is not a bad professor, but I didn't really enjoy his class either. (To be fair, it was ENGR 112 and no ones like that class...) It's hard to get an A and Dr Villareal is not overly helpful (or wasn't for me). His TA seemed to do most of the work for the class and the TA was a fairly harsh grader.
reviews.ratingTags: Skip class? You won't pass.--LOTS OF HOMEWORK--GROUP PROJECTS

reviews.comment: Dr. Villareal was a great professor and very funny. ENGR112 is all around a very confusing class but compared to all other ENGR112 professors, he was one of the best especially with his new DSTR system. Grade revolves around building the DSTR robot and it is actually a lot of fun building. The other half of the semester is exactly like ENGR111.
reviews.ratingTags: Skip class? You won't pass.--BEWARE OF POP QUIZZES--Hilarious

reviews.comment: Passionate about his work, however that passion does not equate to teaching ability. He talks about himself most of the time, which leads to him rushing class presentations. He believes in the "throw your child into the pool if they want to learn how to swim approach," & said LabView & MatLab heavy, those who excel need previous experience coding
reviews.ratingTags: Skip class? You won't pass.--Hilarious--GROUP PROJECTS

reviews.comment: Group activities are key in ENGR111, and if you miss class, you don't get a chance to make it up. Communicated the material very clearly and kept me engaged for the full 2 hours.
reviews.ratingTags: Participation matters--Skip class? You won't pass.--LECTURE HEAVY

reviews.comment: He goes too fast and doesn't explain things well. The student teachers and TA do a way better job at explaining. They taught me more than he did. Also he talks about himself way too much. The class itself involved a lot of self teaching, and working with others. The class felt disorganized, and I dunno if its because of the course itself or him.
reviews.ratingTags: Tough Grader--Skip class? You won't pass.--BEWARE OF POP QUIZZES

reviews.comment: He is enthusiastic, and loves what he does. He made the lectures interesting, and even though the class is difficult he does care how well you do and will try to help you understand the material.

Dr. V was a nice guy that liked to crack jokes throughout his lectures. However he went through the material very fast and was very easy to get lost. Blame that more on the design of the course rather than the professor. Also tried going to his office hours twice and wasn't there. His TA seemed to be more accessible for help.

Engineering 111 is matlab and labview heavy, and he didn't necessarily teach how to use the programs. He's entertaining, but he goes very fast when lecturing and it's easy to get lost. Be ready to teach yourself most of the concepts. There are several, smaller group projects throughout the semester but only 2, free-response exams and no final.
reviews.ratingTags: Skip class? You won't pass.--LOTS OF HOMEWORK--Hilarious

reviews.comment: Dr. V is an amazing prof, he's hilarious and engages his students in the class. He could work on his understanding of some of the material given he has his Ph.D in Electrical engineering and not in matlab. Be prepared to work your butt off, but he really makes this class much better than it seems. I'm taking him for 112 because I like him so much!

He is  a really cool professor. He gives out 'coke questions' randomly in class and most people get to be asked a question and if you get it he gives you a any soda of your choice. I respected him. He and his TA work together and make a solid team.
reviews.ratingTags: Skip class? You won't pass.--Hilarious--GROUP PROJECTS

reviews.comment: He's a really nice guy. He didn't always know the material completely, which hurt his lectures. He relied on his TA a lot. As a team, they get the job done. He didn't give a ton of homework until the latter part of the semester, but at that point, every ENGR 111 class had a lot of homework. He's usually available at any time upon appointment.
